title: SEXTOLUGAR — Entry
subtitle:
You're about to cross the line.
Breathe. Read. And choose carefully.
whisper: Silence is part of the game.
protocol:
Before starting, confirm you understand:
the cards are physical — the site only guides the pace.

modal.title: The Ritual — Quick read
modal.intro: The site doesn't replace the cards. It only controls time and atmosphere.
modal.step1: Set out the physical deck and clear the table.
modal.step2: Choose a mode: solo or group (decided at the table).
modal.step3: When the timer runs, follow the instructions on the drawn card.
modal.step4: If the timer hits zero, the round ends — even if someone wants "just one more".
modal.warn: The game works with 3 to 5 people. The "silence" is a rule of mood, not of solitude.
